_about: Spell interdependencies the importer can't read from the game's spell descriptions (tools/simc_spells.py). By class. source: the cast spell's SimC token, or "*" with power = resource type for 'per point spent'. seconds: number, "reset" or "charge". requires: talent spell ID (0 = none). covers: the start of the description sentence this rule replaces, so it leaves the review list. Merged on every weekly import.
